Paper Identification.Title: Heat Transfer and Friction in Channels With Two Opposite Rib Roughened Walls
Paper Identification.Study Objective: An experimental study of fully developed turbulent air flow in square ducts with two opposite rib roughened walls to determine the effects of rib pitch to height and rib height to equivalent diameter ratios on friction factor and heat transfer coefficients.

Fluid Properties: Air at room temperature and pressure

Reported Dependent Variables: Stanton number on the two smooth walls (St2s)
Stanton number on the two ribbed walls (St2r)
